summary: Hand-written sample Work Map so the tutor works before any real capture session.

skills.title: Add modifier 25 when an E/M visit and a minor procedure share a date

action.detail: Append modifier 25 to the E/M code

skills.expert_explanation: If they did the injection the same day, the payer assumes the visit was just the pre-procedure check. Twenty-five tells them the visit was its own thing. No 25, and the E/M gets bundled away.

guardrail.description: E/M billed with a same-day procedure must carry modifier 25

skills.title: Hold advanced imaging without prior auth

action.detail: Hold the claim and request the auth number from the front desk

skills.expert_explanation: BCBS will deny an MRI with no auth every single time, and a denial is way harder to fix than a hold. I hold it and chase the auth first.

guardrail.description: Imaging without prior auth must not be submitted

skills.title: Query the physician when the note isn't signed

action.detail: Send a query asking the provider to sign the note, and hold the claim

skills.expert_explanation: An unsigned note is no note as far as an auditor is concerned. I never send it out, I ping the doctor and park it.

guardrail.description: Unsigned documentation requires a physician query and a hold

skills.title: Use POS 10 with modifier 95 for Medicare telehealth from home

action.detail: Add modifier 95 to the visit code

skills.expert_explanation: For Medicare video visits at home we keep POS 10 and add 95. People forget the 95 and it comes back paid at the wrong rate.

guardrail.description: Medicare telehealth from home needs modifier 95
